answer: A newcomer files a public wharf manifest listing each job's inputs before doing it; the manifest is split into nebula shards, each re-run live by a different stranger staking 2 POA, and all shards must verify before the horizon at epoch end or the 6 POA wharf bond is slashed. The nth identity from one wallet files n manifests, posting 6n² POA (1st 6, 10th 600, 2,310 across ten); one operator cannot run ten live manifests at once, and a copied manifest is public proof of fraud.
